shots.action: Open browser, show hero section with live stats
shots.narrate: "AutoTasker Hub is a machine-payable data marketplace built on x402. Real settlements, real splits, all verifiable on chain."
"This is the free sample endpoint — no payment required. Real China public market data, returned instantly."
shots.note: Shows the API works without payment

shots.narrate: "Now hit the paid endpoint. We get a 402 Payment Required, and inside accepts[0] you see three things named in three places: the facilitator, the asset tUSD8, the amount. That triple-naming is an x402 requirement."
shots.note: Facilitator must appear in root, accepts[0].facilitator, accepts[0].extra.facilitator

shots.narrate: "The settlement layer is CapitalMobilizerV2, deployed on QDay Aevum testnet. It's not a simulation — every number here is a real transaction hash you can click into."

shots.action: Click into tx 0xc04c1631... (the 10-payment batch), point out gas per payment
shots.narrate: "A single charge costs about 221k gas. But batch ten charges into one transaction and it drops to 23,745 gas per payment. At one gwei that fraction of a cent makes sub-five-cent API pricing actually viable."

"Here's the proof: 988 real settlements on official tUSD8. Same 47.95 token carried eight hundred five dollars gross. System float conserved at one hundred percent because gas is paid in tQDAY, not in the settlement token. And every single transaction passes the invariant check."
shots.note: Key numbers: 988 payments, $805.40 gross, 16.8x velocity, 100% conserved

shots.screen: Terminal: run commission-proof or wallet status
shots.narrate: "Three ledgers, three destinations. House wallet received zero point six eight zero five eight. Referrer received zero point zero seven five six two. Treasury received zero point zero zero three eight. And the router balance is exactly zero because everything that came in was paid out."

shots.action: Scroll to the realized revenue = $0 line
shots.narrate: "One honest line in the documentation: realized revenue is zero dollars. tUSD8 has no market value. What we proved is the rail works and the arithmetic is exact. That's the difference between a hackathon project and a product."
shots.note: Critical honesty moment — builds judge trust

shots.screen: Quick scroll through GitHub repo structure
shots.action: Show README.md top section with real contract address
shots.narrate: "Everything is reproduced from the repo. Anyone can clone, deploy against their own token, and verify the same split arithmetic. The deployment guide takes about one command."
